name: morphicons
tagline: Universal morphing for stroke-based icons with spring physics
description: morphicons lets any icon morph into any other — universal morphing for stroke-based icons (Lucide, Tabler, Heroicons, Iconoir, or your own paths) with spring physics and zero runtime dependencies at roughly 7 KB gzip. Rotations are never declared by hand; they emerge from the math (2D Procrustes alignment plus polar interpolation), so arrow-right to arrow-down turns 90 degrees on its own. The library ships bindings for React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, a vanilla DOM driver, and a pure core with format adapters for SVG markup and CSS-mask and canvas targets. It consumes icon data rather than components, exposes uncontrolled, controlled, and imperative morph modes with truly interruptible springs, honors reduced-motion policies, and is measured at sub-millisecond planning with zero numeric allocation per frame. A live playground at morphicons.com demonstrates 38 icons across Lucide, Feather, and Tabler.
highlights: Universal morphing for stroke-based icons with spring physics and zero runtime dependencies (~7 KB gzip)
Rotations emerge from 2D Procrustes + polar interpolation — no hand-declared rotation groups
React, Vue, Svelte, React Native bindings plus vanilla DOM driver and pure core
Truly interruptible springs with velocity preservation and reduced-motion policies
Sub-millisecond planning and zero numeric allocation per frame
curatorNote: A mathematically sophisticated icon library that solves the icon-morph problem in closed form — no per-pair configuration, just spring physics and Procrustes alignment. 900 stars in its first week, and the playground makes it instantly fun to try.
